# PhoneCam OBS

> Free, open-source way to use an Android phone as a camera in OBS Studio, over a USB cable or local Wi-Fi. Up to 4K hardware video (H.264/H.265), optional phone microphone, phone screen sharing, and control of the phone from OBS. No account, no watermark, no analytics. Mac (Apple Silicon, OBS 33) supported; Windows in preview. Licence: GPL-2.0-or-later.

## Use it

- [README: install and use](https://github.com/VaraKare/phonecam-obs#readme): phone app (APK) + OBS plugin; add the "PhoneCam (phone camera)" source; tap the red record button on the phone.
- [Releases](https://github.com/VaraKare/phonecam-obs/releases): ready-made downloads with what was tested on real hardware.
- [Which phones and computers work](https://github.com/VaraKare/phonecam-obs/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)
- [Latest version guide (v0.6)](https://github.com/VaraKare/phonecam-obs/blob/main/docs/versions/v0.6.md): OBS controls, microphone, screen sharing, warnings.
